algorithm.summary: SHA-256("interweave/topic/v1\0" || channel_id_ascii). Keeps raw channel names off the wire; it does not resist dictionary guessing of a low-entropy name.
algorithm.wire_topic: The GossipSub topic string is the lowercase hexadecimal encoding of the 32-byte key: 64 characters from [0-9a-f], no prefix, no separator. It is part of the contract since 2026-10-09 (PUBSUB.md, architect-cto's ruling 01a11e68); before that the text left the encoding to the implementation, and every build already emitted this form.
